notes.title: Freeware Garden: Fork Parker s Holiday Profit Hike
notes.notes:
Fork Parker’s Holiday Profit Hike may just be one of the best known freeware games recently released, being a little something by indie mega label Devolver. It’s also, yes, a holiday-themed game, but that’s okay – I’m pretty certain there’s a blizzard waiting to happen somewhere in the coming months. It’s too good to ignore, anyway.

Fork Parker’s platformer is built around Devolver’s balding CFO mascot’s attempts to climb a snowy and rather festive mountain of money in a cunning bid to help raise his company’s revenue. Among the lovely pixelated graphics, happy enemies and spiky spikes, Mr. Parker will try to collect wads of cash and avoid any falls that might lead to ludicrous medical bills.

notes.title: Small update - now with key binding!
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody!

We've been following your feedback, and just pushed an update that should allow you to rebind your controls to whatever you desire. 

This should also allow you to bind any controllers that weren't being properly recognized before!

Sorry for lacking this feature out of the gate. We made this little game in just a few days as a little Devolver treat, and ended up missing a few critical things!

I hope that all of you who weren't able to play can now enjoy a little mountain profiteering.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fork Parker's Holiday Profit Hike
notes.notes:
Fork Parker's Holiday Profit Hike is Now Available on Steam for free!

Against explosive firepower, bitter cold, and dizzying heights, Fork Parker must outwit a group of no-talent game developers in a deadly holiday promotional game. Also, did we mention it's free!?
